# From Azure Boards to specs

After a Cursor plugin install, the short command loop is [plugins/crav1/README.md](../plugins/crav1/README.md).

When the user asks for startup options, that ask names only `/crav1-spark-to-spec`, `/crav1-ideas-to-spec`, `/crav1-bundle-to-specs`, `/crav1-existing-to-specs`, `/crav1-read-environment`, and `/crav1-fix-bug`.

## First prompt

```text
/crav1-ado-sync
```

```text
/crav1-ado-sync
52 81
```

## Steps

### What it reads

Ids come from every `docs/specs/<slug>/work-item.md` and from `## No spec yet in ADO` in `docs/system/landscape.md`, unless the user named ids. Discussion comments use an api version current `az` can parse.

`az` is checked the same way as `/crav1-ado-sync`. A failure states the issue, suggests a fix such as `az login`, and offers a skip.

### What the user sees

A kept change goes to the spec through `/crav1-add-to-spec`, labelled as coming from Azure Boards with the date and who changed it.

A Feature with no spec yet suggests making the spec first, for example `/crav1-spark-to-spec`, from what was written on the Feature.

It shows `Post comment on Feature <id>: <text>`.

## What gets written

A kept change, and an answer the user gives during the run, go to the spec through `/crav1-add-to-spec`.

## After

```text
/crav1-finalize-commit
```

A Feature with no spec yet: run the starter it suggested, for example [`/crav1-spark-to-spec`](from-nothing.md).

Reference page: [ado-sync](reference/skills/crav1-ado-sync.md)

The run ends as [How a run ends](reference/run-ending.md) says: Run next, never a `Next:` line, `Waiting:` only when a step is blocked, and `Uncommitted:` when files changed and are not committed.

human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.205.0/docs/from-ado-sync-pull-spec-changes.md
